summary: YouTube Studio now suggests products for affiliate creators to tag, showing each merchant's estimated commission rate next to the picks.
An Amazon Associates user on Reddit reports failed OneLink payments for UK and Canada commissions in October, despite correct bank details.
Lasso, URLgenius and Button/Posttap were quiet; several Reddit competitor searches were rate-limited (429) again.

items.title: Anyone had failed Amazon OneLink payments despite using the correct bank details?
items.why: OneLink is Amazon's own cross-store tool; payment problems for non-US stores are a real pain point for international creators.

items.title: YouTube Studio now suggests products for affiliate creators to tag
items.why: YouTube is steering creators to products and showing commission rates inside Studio, keeping more of the link choice inside its own tools.
